test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct form:

He said that he would join the meeting after lunch.

options.text: “I will join the meeting after lunch,” he said.
“I would join the meeting after lunch,” he said.
“I shall join the meeting after lunch,” he said.
“I can join the meeting after lunch,” he said.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that he would join the meeting after lunch.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"He would join" becomes "I will join"**
 
 
• The modal verb &q
